checks.title: Worked example

checks.detail: All 17 outputs equal the hand calculation to the output quantum (0.0000000001).

checks.title: No change, no effect
checks.description: With every scenario change at zero, every output attributed to the changes is zero.
checks.detail: All 10 outputs attributed to the changes are zero.

checks.title: The accounting bridge closes
checks.description: The bridge's steps add up exactly to the change it explains.
checks.detail: −gross_fuel_cost_change + −hedging_effect + fare_recovery = operating_profit_change (-3550000).

checks.title: Months add up to the horizon
checks.description: Each monthly series adds up to the matching total over the horizon.
checks.detail: Over 12 months, the monthly values of fuel_cost_change, fare_recovery, operating_profit_change add up to their totals.

checks.title: Contributions add up
checks.description: With several changes at once, each output equals the sum of the changes' contributions (Shapley values), whatever their interaction.
checks.detail: With 2 changes at once, each of the 10 attributed outputs equals the sum of its contributions (Shapley values).

checks.title: Linear where the equations are linear
checks.description: Doubling a quantity the equations are linear in doubles its effect.
checks.detail: crude_oil_change 10 → 20: fuel_cost_change 5250000 → 10500000.

checks.title: The effect moves one way
checks.description: As a change grows, its effect moves in one direction at every step.
checks.detail: fuel_cost_change rises at every step as crude_oil_change goes -20 → -10 → 0 → 10 → 20 → 40.

checks.title: Units do not change the result
checks.description: The same volume and price stated in other units (exact conversions) give the same result.
checks.detail: 3 statements of the same fuel volume and price (barrels, gallons, mixed) give identical baseline_fuel_cost, fuel_cost_change, fare_recovery, operating_profit_change, scenario_operating_margin.

checks.detail: 9 inputs: every documented limit is accepted, and a value just beyond it is refused. Each limit runs with the worked example's other figures.
